name: certify
description: Plataforma de Emision y Gestion de Credenciales Digitales

scripts.setup: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c "cd /app && npm install"
scripts.check: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend npm run check:all
scripts.test: docker compose exec backend npm test -w backend
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec backend npm run db:migrate -w backend
scripts.db:deploy: docker compose exec backend npm run db:deploy -w backend
scripts.db:status: docker compose exec backend npm run db:status -w backend
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec backend npm run db:seed -w backend
scripts.db:studio: docker compose exec backend npm run db:studio -w backend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec backend npm run db:reset -w backend
scripts.check:all: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.backup:storage: tar -czf storage/backup.tar.gz -C storage certificates logos signatures
scripts.backup: npm run down && npm run backup:db && npm run backup:storage && npm run up
scripts.restore:storage: rm -rf storage/certificates storage/logos storage/signatures && tar -xzf storage/backup.tar.gz -C storage && mkdir -p storage/signatures
scripts.restore: npm run down && npm run restore:db && npm run restore:storage && npm run up
scripts.remake: npm run down && rm -rf database/data storage/certificates storage/logos storage/signatures && npm run up:build
